title: Neural Optimal Transport with General Cost Functionals
tldr_zh: NOT 的 max-min 推广到任意凸 lsc 泛函 F(pi)，无位势凸性假设的 duality-gap 界；class-guided 泛函用每类 10 标签实现保类翻译
tldr_en: Generalizes the NOT saddle-point solver to arbitrary convex lsc cost functionals F(pi), proves a duality-gap bound without potential convexity, and builds class- and pair-guided functionals.
key_numbers: FMNIST->MNIST class accuracy: F_G 83.22% vs NOT W2 10.96%, MUNIT 8.93%, OTDD 10.28%, Sinkhorn LpL1 10.67% with 10 target labels per class (Table 1)
FMNIST->MNIST FID: F_G 5.26 vs NOT W2 7.51, MUNIT 7.91, AugCycleGAN 26.35 (Table 2); MNIST->MNIST-M FID 6.67 vs 19.43/11.68 (Table 2)
MNIST->MNIST-M accuracy: F_G 94.62% vs MUNIT 97.95%, AugCycleGAN 98.2% (Table 1)
MNIST->KMNIST accuracy: F_G no z 79.20%, F_G 61.91% vs all baselines <13% (Table 3)
rho(pi_T, pi*) <= sqrt(2/beta)(sqrt(eps1)+sqrt(eps2)) for beta-strongly convex F, no assumption on potential (Theorem 3)
Compute: 5-15 hours on one V100 16GB for image data (Appendix C.1)
